name: Project Smash
desc:
Max Level: 200

🖥️ Controls:

• Attack: Left Click (X on Console)
• Multi-Jump: Space (can be used up to three times)
• Dash: Q (L3 on Console)
• Block: F (RB on Console)
• Emotes: B (R-Dpad on Console)

Airborne Maneuvers:
• Uppercut: While in the air, look up and click. (Y on Console)
• Down Slam: While in the air, look down and click. (B on Console)
